story.text: …따라와요. 오늘은 딴 데 안 가고, 할 말 있어서 불렀어요.
story.reading: …tta-ra-wa-yo. o-neul-eun ttan de an ga-go, hal mal iss-eo-seo bul-leoss-eo-yo.
story.en: ...Come with me. We're not going anywhere else today, I called you here because I have something to say.

story.text: 저기 '별' 보여요? 한옥마을 지붕 위로 뜬 거. …오늘따라 잘 보이네요.
story.reading: jeo-gi 'byeol' bo-yeo-yo? han-ok-ma-eul ji-bung wi-ro tteun geo. …o-neul-tta-ra jal bo-i-ne-yo.
story.en: Can you see that 'star'? Rising above the Hanok Village roofs. ...It's especially clear tonight.

story.text: …이런 거 잘 못 해요, 원래. 그래도 오늘은 '고백' 좀 하려고요.
story.reading: …i-reon geo jal mos hae-yo, won-lae. geu-rae-do o-neul-eun 'go-baek' jom ha-ryeo-go-yo.
story.en: ...I'm not good at this sort of thing, usually. But today I'm going to make a 'confession'.

story.text: …무뚝뚝해서 몰랐겠지만, 스케줄 조정한 것도, 다 '진심'이었어요. 처음부터.
story.reading: …mu-ttuk-ttuk-hae-seo mol-lass-get-ji-man, seu-ke-jul jo-jeong-han geot-do, da 'jin-sim'i-eoss-eo-yo. cheo-eum-bu-teo.
story.en: ...You probably didn't know because I'm so blunt, but even rearranging my schedule — it was all 'sincere'. From the very beginning.

story.text: …'손' 좀 줘봐요. 이렇게 잡고 있는 게, 훨씬 나아서요.
story.reading: …'son' jom jwo-bwa-yo. i-reoh-ge jap-go it-neun ge, hwol-ssin na-a-seo-yo.
story.en: ...Give me your 'hand'. Holding it like this feels so much better.

story.text: 앞으로도 곁에 있을게요. 진지하게 생각하고 있어요, 오래도록. 이거 하나는 '약속'해요.
story.reading: ap-eu-ro-do gyeot-e iss-eul-ge-yo. jin-ji-ha-ge saeng-gak-ha-go iss-eo-yo, o-rae-do-rok. i-geo ha-na-neun 'yak-sok'hae-yo.
story.en: I'll stay by your side from now on too. I'm thinking about this seriously, for the long run. This much, I 'promise'.

story.text: …서툴어도, 이 정도면 분명하죠? 자, 이제 진짜 마지막 문제예요.
story.reading: …seo-tul-eo-do, i jeong-do-myeon bun-myeong-ha-jyo? ja, i-je jin-jja ma-ji-mak mun-je-ye-yo.
story.en: ...Even if I'm clumsy at this, this much is clear, right? Alright, this is really the last question now.

words.example_en: The stars twinkle in the night sky.

sentences.en: It's a night full of stars.
I hope my sincerity gets through to you.
We hold hands and look at the stars.
